Reversible arthral- gia has sometimes occurred with the fluoroquinolones;1 joint erosions have been documented in immature animals. In a re- port,2 treatment with pefloxacin may have contributed to the de- structive arthropathy that occurred in a 17-year-old youth. For a discussion of the use of fluoroquinolones in children and adoles- cents, see Administration in Children, under Precautions, below.
